Requires extensions in Mod mode. The original game entry, Safe Mode, disabled extensions and Silenced units skip this rule. The attack frame must have started and remained uncancelled. The source must still be the same instance in that attack's lane. There is one root extension slot. It cannot be combined with another after-attack behavior or another root Grant marker. Unknown forms are preserved and cannot be overwritten.

block.extension.pvzh.rule.delayed_destro: Full example: At the original Play timing, manually select a living unit in play and destroy it after two native turn boundaries. Play includes applicable native events for playing, spawning, transforming and revealing. The template derives its source guard from the existing play recipe for the current unit or Trick. Authors can inspect the conditions and adjust the turn count.

Requires extended abilities in Mod mode. The original game entry, Safe Mode and disabled extensions skip this rule. It tracks the same instance in play even when it moves. Death, return to hand, reset or transformation cancels it. Reapplying it retains only the earliest expiry. Regular instant buffs are not delayed. The original native Duration field is preserved, and this rule manages the delay state.

An integer from 1 to 32. The native TurnStartEffect.TurnCount marks turn boundaries. Add this value to the count at application. The existing runtime treats legacy 0 as 1 while preserving stored data. New input starts at 1.
Manual editing, native saving and UI checks are recorded separately. The original engine and full-match effect have not passed acceptance for this release.

The delay state cannot be restored across processes. It cancels if the target is invalidated or the model generation changes. If the old source becomes invalid, the target itself is used as the resolution source to avoid reusing an expired source identity.
Use as an effect component in an ability group, alongside an actual trigger, manual player targeting and a query for a living unit in play. Timing starts when this effect is actually applied.
Schedule a selected unit in play for destruction after 1 to 32 native turn boundaries.

Check the current card's source conditions using the existing play recipe. Manually choose a living, targetable unit in a lane and destroy it after two native turn boundaries. Native Play also covers applicable paths such as spawning, transforming and revealing. Effect acceptance is recorded separately.

block.extension.pvzh.rule.no_attack_this: The full example selects a unit in play at the native Play timing and prevents it from attacking this turn. Authors can inspect the trigger and target query. The component has no freely editable numeric parameters.

Requires extensions in Mod mode. The original game entry, Safe Mode and disabled extensions skip this rule. The restriction is tracked on the same instance and clears after the next native SunCount end-of-turn resource refresh. Removing or resetting the instance clears it. If the original attack check encounters Silenced, it removes the restriction. This does not permanently disable attacks or freeze the unit.
Full resolution at the native turn end, with queued attacks, special phases and multi-lane attacks, has not passed original engine acceptance for this release.
The underlying action does not automatically validate arbitrary author queries. The complete example targets living units in play. It does not establish support for Heroes or arbitrary zones.

Use as an effect component in an ability group, alongside an actual trigger, manual player selection and a query for a living unit in play. The complete example includes the matching target conditions.
Prevent the selected unit in play from attacking this turn.

Use the existing Play source guard to manually select a living unit in play. It cannot attack this turn. The restriction clears after the next native end-of-turn resource refresh. See the help for other applicable Play paths and full-match limits.

block.extension.pvzh.rule.self_no_attack: Apply the ability to a unit that has positive Strength. In normal combat its lane attack is blocked while its displayed card and Strength retain the author's settings.
Requires Mod mode with the corresponding extension enabled. Silence disables the rule. Base Strength and damage resolved separately by abilities or Tricks follow their usual rules.
A comparison in Mod2 already verified native attack prevention. Device and engine acceptance for this authoring entry is recorded separately.
Choose an extended unit ability on the unit's Traits tab. It shares one slot with the other extended unit abilities.
A unit with this ability cannot make lane attacks governed by the rule.
block.extension.pvzh.rule.wounded_unlock: Use a unit with positive Strength that can survive a hit. Observe the restriction before the hit, let the same unit lose Health, then compare its attacks in later combat.

Requires Mod mode with the corresponding extension enabled. Silence disables the rule. Damage fully absorbed by Armor does not unlock it. Healing preserves the unlocked state. Recycling the entity or resetting the card clears it. Other attack restrictions still resolve separately.
Mod2 already has native evidence for unlocking after damage and a comparison in which only Health was added. Device and engine acceptance for this authoring entry is recorded separately.
